tmwjj7v6aphh3.title: Lola Bunny (Loony Tunes)
tmwjj7v6aphh3.description:
McDonald's Toy. Got it when I was 8 or 9 years old. I used to love eating only the patty of my Happy meal haha :) . Was obsessed with Looney tunes, especially the roadrunner one. But now I occasionally rewatch them to get a nostalgic hit every now and then. 
The figure is almost completely new, no scratches, and I didn't play much with it, so it's not worn out.
